jim-dear.text: Sits on the council that voted unanimously (Apr 2026) to adopt the development agreement for a 1,115-unit mixed-use project (764 apartments, 351 townhomes) on the former Imperial Avalon mobilehome park site.

source.title: Carson Accountability & Transparency: City Council Meeting Highlights, April 7, 2026

jim-dear.text: Part of the unanimous vote (Mar 2026) extending Carson's drive-through restaurant moratorium to January 2027; said 'We have so many fast food restaurants in Carson right now... It really discourages the type of restaurants' the city wants to attract.

source.title: Carson Accountability & Transparency: City Council Meeting Highlights, March 3, 2026

jim-dear.text: (2020) Told CAT's candidate Q&A: 'We should not spend any more money than the revenue that we receive,' criticizing budgets balanced by transfers from the Reserve Fund as a structural deficit.

source.title: Carson Accountability & Transparency: 2020 City Candidates Q&A

jim-dear.text: (2020) Said he would vote no on Measure K, Carson's 3/4-cent sales tax, preferring a 'blocking measure' to keep revenue from going to the county if it raised taxes.

source.title: Carson Accountability & Transparency: 2020 City Candidates Q&A

jim-dear.text: (2020) Said new businesses Carson attracts 'should bring Carson residents jobs in high tech clean industries.'

source.title: Carson Accountability & Transparency: 2020 City Candidates Q&A
